note: Near two-row RTL layout where the top-left panel (p2) is taller and pokes ~0.065 across the row boundary — about 0.17 of its own height, under maxStraddleRatio (0.25) but well over the old absolute 0.03 tolerance. The old algorithm finds no clean horizontal gutter, falls to a vertical cut, and reads the right column before the left (p1,p3,p2,p4). The scored cut snaps each straddler to its majority side and keeps the row structure: top row right-to-left, then bottom row.
